about: Warnings the HL7 FHIR Validator is EXPECTED to report on libs/pulsebridge_fhir/examples/, read by scripts/fhir-validate.sh. An entry matches a warning only if ALL of these hold: message_id equals the validator's message key (when given); every text_contains string occurs in the message (quote enough of it, closing quote or bracket included, that a look-alike code does not match); and the warning's location, normalised to '<ResourceType>.<element path>' (Bundle.entry[N].resource/*Type/id*/ becomes Type), is exactly one of 'locations'. 'when': 'always', or 'terminology' if the warning only appears when a terminology server is used. Every entry needs a reason. Only warnings can be listed: an ERROR is never allow-listed. A warning that matches no entry is NEW and fails the run. 'status': 'documented' means libs/pulsebridge_fhir/README.md explains the choice; 'reported' means T08 reported it to the library owner as a possible improvement and it is accepted until they decide.

expected_warnings.reason: Heart-rate minimum component (component[0]) uses LOINC 96935-2. Observation.component.code in the R4 vital-signs profile is bound EXTENSIBLY to observation-vitalsignresult, which has no minimum/maximum codes; an extensible binding allows another code when the value set has none suitable. Deliberate divergence, see the README 'Conformance to the R4 Vital Signs profiles' and 'Heart rate: value, components and the LOINC codes'.
Heart-rate maximum component (component[1]) uses LOINC 55426-1; same extensible-binding divergence as the minimum (README, 'Conformance to the R4 Vital Signs profiles').

text_contains: A definition for CodeSystem 'urn:pulsebridge:recording-method' could not be found
expected_warnings.reason: Provenance.agent.role carries the source's recording method (PASSIVELY_MEASURED) in the local code system urn:pulsebridge:recording-method, which has no published CodeSystem resource, so the validator cannot check the code. agent.role has only an example binding, so a local code is allowed (README, 'Provenance' and 'urn:pulsebridge:* code systems').

Patient.identifier[0].type is v2-0203 PT (Patient external identifier). Identifier.type is bound EXTENSIBLY to the R4 IdentifierType value set, a short subset of v2-0203 that does not include PT; an extensible binding allows another code when none in the set fits (MR would claim a medical record number), and OpenEMR searches patients by their PT identifier (spike S1, T15). Deliberate, see the README 'Identifiers'.

AuditEvent.subtype is v2-0003 R01 (the HL7v2 trigger event attempted). R4 binds subtype EXTENSIBLY to audit-event-sub-type, which holds the DICOM audit event codes 110120 to 110142 (application start and stop, login and logout, security and similar events) and the FHIR REST interactions; none of them names an HL7v2 message send, so another code is allowed. Deliberate, see the README 'AuditEvent for a cuff send attempt (T31)', 'The model'.

text_contains: Constraint failed: dom-6: 'A resource should have narrative for robust management'
expected_warnings.reason: dom-6 is a best-practice invariant ('A resource should have narrative'). The library writes no Resource.text for any of the five resource types it builds: text is optional in R4 and the dashboard renders the data itself. Deliberate, see the README 'No narrative (text)'.
